Resource Corner Pty Ltd has been built on the principles of integrity, partnership and innovation, traits that have allowed Resource Corner to establish itself as leader in its field since 2006. Resource Corner is global technology enterprise, focused on delivering excellence in complex digital environment, with relentless dedication in IT consulting and services. Resource Corner IT has been working with Banking and Telecom and Federal Department to help them achieve business agility, competitive edge, and growth. 
Job location:

Head Office is in Norwest Business Park, Norwest NSW 2153, you will be required to work on clients' office (on multiple locations possible), depending on the engagement, whilst remaining a direct employee of Resource Corner

Type of position:  permanent ongoing 

Minimum Qualification: Any bachelor’s degree in major computing or equalent

Experience Range:
5 to 15 years

Job Description – Developer / Programmer 

The overview of this role involves interpreting the specifications, technical designs and flow charts., It also mainly involves building, maintaining and modifying the code for software applications, constructs technical specifications from a business functional model, and tests and writes technical documentation. You will also be researching, consulting, analyzing and evaluating system program needs. 
You will also be involved in identifying technology limitations and deficiencies in existing systems and associated processes, procedures and methods. Furthermore, you will be required to perform testing, debugging, diagnosing and correcting errors and faults in an applications programming language within established testing protocols, guidelines and quality standards to ensure programs and applications perform to specification. 

In addition, you will be writing and maintaining program code to meet system requirements, system designs and technical specifications in accordance with quality accredited standards. 

Other Developer Programmer related responsibilities as required
To be considered for this role, you will have as per the below Job Description

Detailed Job description: -

Primary or Mandatory skills: -
Minimum 5 years of real time experience in below technologies:
•	Develop, build, review and test frontend and backend software solutions
•	Work with other developers and business to propose high quality system solutions to meet business goals
•	Provides support including analysis, development, testing and code review
•	Troubleshoot application issues and provide feedback for enhancement
•	Designing, coding, and implementing solutions using Salesforce applications
•	Involved in Database design of all the analytical models from the scratch.
•	Created DB procedures, functions, cursors, triggers, views for the execution of the analytical models
•	Complete Analytical model structure development in the Database.
•	Involved in the UI development on the web pages and template design.
•	Involved in the requirements gathering process
•	Creation of table structures for customer and merchant transactions.
•	UNIX scripts for automation of daily batch load process.
•	Analysis of business and technical requirements, prototyping.
•	Database design for system configuration.
•	Performance tuning of oracle database and user applications.

Skillset Required
· Must have hands on to work on tools like Python, SQL,  Machine Learning, DOCKER, Cloud Computing AWS AZURE, Core java, J2EE, Spring Boot / Spring Micro-service, PL/SQL. Spring Tool Suite, AWS cloud server, Oracle ADF, Java.
· Agile ways of working
. Strong Analytical and problem-solving skills

Good to have skills: -
Good to have Jenkins and Terraforms knowledge along with support tools (Docker, Git, Bash, AWS CLI)

Roles and Responsibilities
Associate must be capable of handling the business requirements of the customer and working with internal teams in getting the requirements fulfilled may it new or enhancement on existing.
Should be able to identify risks early on and plan how to manage them to maximizing the chances of delivery project success.
Salary: $100k to $150k plus super

Next steps 

If you feel this opportunity suits you, or RESOURCE CORNER IT is the type of organization you would like to join, we want to have a conversation with you! Please apply directly with us.

For a complete list of open opportunities with RESOURCE CORNER IT, visit http://www.resourcecornerit.com
This is an exciting opportunity to join in an innovative team in Norwest, NSW 2153 this is a newly created Fulltime position - Monday to Friday from 8.30am to 4.30pm in a friendly, professional working environment which focuses on customer solution strategy. 

If you have a passion for leveraging the best from cutting-edge technologies; have an eye for elegance, flexibility and efficiency in design; and are passionate about technology we want to hear from you.

RESOURCE CORNER IT is committed to providing Equal Employment Opportunities. Successful candidates will be required to undergo a background check.

Key Responsibilities:

Financial Management
Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements in accordance with Australian Accounting Standards.
Develop and maintain comprehensive financial reporting systems for construction and property development projects.
Analyse financial performance and provide strategic recommendations to improve profitability and operational efficiency.
Monitor company cash flow and maintain adequate working capital for multiple concurrent construction projects.
Prepare management reports, financial dashboards, and performance analysis for executive decision-making.

Project Accounting
Monitor project budgets, construction expenditure, and development costs across residential and commercial projects.
Analyse project profitability, cost variances, and financial performance against approved budgets.
Prepare project feasibility analyses and financial forecasts for proposed developments.
Monitor work-in-progress, project revenue recognition, and construction contract accounting.
Assist management in evaluating investment opportunities and project financing requirements.

Budgeting and Forecasting
Prepare annual operating budgets and long-term financial forecasts.
Develop project-specific budgets and monitor financial performance throughout project lifecycles.
Conduct variance analysis and recommend corrective actions where required.
Support strategic business planning through financial modelling and scenario analysis.

Taxation and Regulatory Compliance
Prepare and review Business Activity Statements (BAS), GST, PAYG, payroll tax, Fringe Benefits Tax (FBT), and income tax information.
Ensure compliance with Australian Taxation Office (ATO) requirements and applicable taxation legislation.
Liaise with external tax advisers regarding taxation planning and compliance matters.
Ensure compliance with ASIC reporting obligations and other statutory requirements.
Maintain accurate accounting records in accordance with legislative and regulatory requirements.

Financial Controls and Risk Management
Develop and implement internal financial control systems and accounting policies.
Review financial procedures to improve efficiency and minimise financial risk.
Monitor company financial risks, including project funding, supplier obligations, and contractual commitments.
Assist in developing financial governance policies and risk management strategies.

Audit and Compliance
Coordinate external audits and provide supporting financial documentation.
Prepare reconciliations, supporting schedules, and audit working papers.
Implement recommendations arising from internal and external audits.
Ensure compliance with accounting standards, corporate governance requirements, and company policies.

Business Advisory
Provide financial advice to directors regarding property acquisitions, developments, renovations, and investment opportunities.
Analyse financing options for commercial and residential development projects.
Evaluate business performance indicators and recommend strategies to improve financial outcomes.
Assist management with pricing strategies, tender evaluations, and investment decisions.

Financial Systems
Maintain and improve accounting systems, financial software, and reporting processes.
Ensure the integrity and accuracy of financial information across all business operations.
Assist in implementing technology solutions that improve financial reporting and operational efficiency.

Stakeholder Management
Liaise with banks, financial institutions, external accountants, auditors, government agencies, suppliers, contractors, and project managers.
Prepare financial information required for loan applications, project funding, and investment proposals.
Support senior management with financial presentations and business reporting.

Essential Qualifications
Bachelor degree or higher qualification in Accounting, Commerce, Finance, or a closely related discipline.
Strong knowledge of Australian Accounting Standards and taxation legislation.
Advanced analytical and financial reporting skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
High level of accuracy, professionalism, and attention to detail.

Desirable Experience
Experience within the property development, construction, building, or real estate industry.
Experience in project accounting and construction cost management.
Knowledge of Australian taxation requirements applicable to property development.
Experience using accounting software such as Xero, MYOB, QuickBooks, or similar enterprise accounting systems.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and financial modelling experience.

Key Competencies
Financial reporting and analysis.
Budget preparation and forecasting.
Project accounting and construction cost analysis.
Taxation compliance.
Financial planning and strategic advisory.
Internal controls and corporate governance.
Cash flow management.
Business and investment analysis.
Risk management.
Strong organisational and problem-solving skills.
Performance Outcomes
Accurate and timely financial reporting.
Effective project cost control and budget management.
Full compliance with taxation and statutory obligations.
Improved financial performance and profitability.
Strong financial governance and internal control systems.
Reliable financial advice supporting strategic business decisions.
Working Relationships

The General Accountant works collaboratively with:

Managing Director
Project Managers
Site Supervisors
Contract Administrators
Estimators
External Accountants
Auditors
Tax Advisers
Banks and Financial Institutions
Australian Taxation Office (ATO)
Australian Securities and Investments Commission (ASIC)
Professional Responsibility

The Accountant is expected to maintain confidentiality, comply with all relevant accounting and taxation legislation, uphold ethical professional standards, and contribute to the ongoing financial success and sustainable growth of Maximus Property Holdings Pty Ltd trading as Upbuild Property Solutions.

Salary: $82,000/Annum

# Graphic Design Apprentice

**Brendale, Brisbane QLD**
**Full-time Apprenticeship | Monday–Friday**

## Turn your creativity into a career.

Do you love design? Are you always creating artwork, experimenting with Adobe programs or finding yourself noticing great branding everywhere you go?

Velflex is one of Australia's leading manufacturers of custom heat transfers, supplying apparel decorators, sporting clubs, promotional product businesses and major brands across Australia and New Zealand.

We're looking for a **Graphic Design Apprentice** to join our experienced Graphics team in Brendale.

This is an incredible opportunity to gain a nationally recognised qualification while learning from experienced designers in a real production environment. You'll develop practical skills that can't be taught in a classroom, working on artwork that ends up on sportswear, uniforms, workwear, fashion and promotional products seen right across Australia.

If you're creative, motivated and excited to build a long-term career in graphic design, we'd love to hear from you.

## What you'll be learning

Working alongside our experienced Graphics team, you'll receive hands-on training in:

* Preparing customer artwork for production
* Creating and editing vector artwork using Adobe Illustrator
* Basic image editing in Adobe Photoshop
* Colour matching and artwork adjustments
* Setting up print-ready artwork files
* Understanding heat transfer and garment decoration production processes
* Digital printing workflows and production preparation
* Proofing artwork and quality control
* Managing multiple jobs and meeting production deadlines
* Working closely with our Sales, Customer Service and Production teams to achieve outstanding customer outcomes

As your skills develop, you'll have opportunities to contribute to customer artwork, branding projects, new product development and continuous improvement initiatives.

## About you

We're looking for someone who is passionate about creativity and excited to learn.

You don't need years of experience—we'll provide full training—but you do need the right attitude and a genuine interest in graphic design.

You'll be a great fit if you:

* Have a genuine passion for graphic design and creativity
* Enjoy problem solving and thinking visually
* Have an excellent eye for detail
* Take pride in producing accurate, high-quality work
* Enjoy learning new software and skills
* Are organised and able to manage multiple tasks
* Communicate well and enjoy working with others
* Are reliable, motivated and eager to build a long-term career
* Thrive in a fast-paced environment

It would be great if you also have:

* Basic knowledge of Adobe Illustrator or Photoshop (school, TAFE or personal projects all count)
* A portfolio of school work, personal projects or creative designs (not essential but highly regarded)
* Completed Year 12 (preferred but not essential)

## What you'll gain

This is much more than an apprenticeship.

You'll receive:

* A nationally recognised Graphic Design qualification
* Full on-the-job training and mentoring from experienced designers
* Experience using industry-leading Adobe Creative Cloud software
* Exposure to the latest digital print and garment decoration technology
* Real-world design experience from day one
* Opportunities to work on artwork for well-known Australian brands, sporting clubs and businesses
* A supportive team that genuinely wants to see you succeed
* Long-term career opportunities within a growing Australian company

## Why join Velflex?

Velflex is a proudly family-owned Australian business with a reputation for innovation, quality and exceptional customer service.

Our mission is to deliver industry-leading heat transfer solutions while helping our customers succeed through exceptional products, education and support.

Everything we do is guided by our core values of **Respect, Resilience, Trust, Honesty and Pride**.

When you join Velflex, you'll enjoy:

* A supportive, family-owned team culture
* Modern production and design facilities in Brendale
* On-site parking
* Barista-quality coffee every day
* Regular team BBQs, celebrations and social events
* Company uniforms provided
* Ongoing training and professional development
* Career progression opportunities as the business continues to grow

## Hours

This is a full-time apprenticeship based at our Brendale facility.

Standard hours are **Monday to Friday**, with training provided entirely on-site alongside our experienced Graphics team.

## Ready to start your creative career?

Colormaker Industries Australia is a well-established, family-owned manufacturer of quality coatings for interior and exterior application. Amongst a broad range of technologies, Colormaker also manufactures and exports market leading world class products in textile screen printing inks and high solids epoxy swimming pool coatings. The business is based on Sydney’s Northern Beaches.

We require a dedicated coatings & inks Quality Control (QC) Chemist to join our busy team of specialists in Brookvale, NSW.

Reporting to the Senior Chemist and Technical Manager, the duties and responsibilities of the role will include:

. Performing laboratory tests/QC procedures on paints and raw materials and recommending improvements for Factory Production and Product Development
. Preparing materials for test and/or experimentation
. Performing calculations, computations and measurements
. Analyzing test data results and preparing relevant reviews, reports and summaries
. Auditing and controlling the quality and quantity of materials used in QC tests, R&D and product maintenance
. Checking, calibrating and maintaining test equipment and other laboratory facilities
. Management of Safety Data Sheets, both Raw Materials and Finished Goods
. Technical and other support to Customer Service and Marketing, including translation of technical and other product literature
. Proficient use of Tencia/Arrow, Color I Control and relevant business software (including MS EXCEL). Also use of company systems
. Maintenance of relevant QC and Production records and related administration
. Adhering to appropriate workplace health and safety standards and making recommendations for improvement
. Management of Hazardous Materials and Dangerous Goods.
. Advising and sourcing materials for Research and Development (R&D) projects
. Carrying out product development work on new and existing products

We offer a competitive remuneration package of between $70,000 to $85,000 per annum, excluding superannuation.

The successful candidate will have either:

. A relevant AQF Associate Degree, Advanced Diploma or Diploma plus five (5) years’ work experience; or
. At least ten (10) years of relevant full-time work experience

The successful candidate must have coatings experience. In particular, high solids epoxy, high performance industrial surface coatings, broad wall architectural and construction membranes etc would be highly regarded, as would knowledge of textile and other screen printing ink technologies. They must also be passionate about the environment, have a good eye for colour and for detail as well as an ability to work with minimal supervision. A high degree of numeracy and literacy in English are mandatory, whilst technical fluency in European languages would be highly regarded.  Applicants must have full and permanent working rights in Australia to be considered.

If you feel that you are suited to the role of Quality Control Chemist, then please send your CV to us via email technical@colormaker.com.au.
